design_summary: The audio area covers TUMU's sound effects library and its procedural music system. Sound effects are per-ability .wav assets wired to gameplay events, while the music side is a from-scratch GDScript port of Strudel's pattern algebra driving GDSiON FM synthesis with a live-coding Music Drawer. A composition layer (movements, bridges, turnarounds) sits on top to make music data-driven and reactive to game state.

standalone_designs.title: Pattern Engine Specification
standalone_designs.summary: Implementation-agnostic functional spec for the cycle-based algorithmic music engine: rational time, the Pattern/Hap/TimeSpan algebra, signals, mini-notation grammar, scheduler, audio bridge, and the editor. Written as a clean-room reference describing behavior rather than any specific code.

standalone_designs.title: Strudel v1.2.0 Compatibility Audit
standalone_designs.summary: Cross-cutting feature-by-feature audit of what the GDScript port supports versus Strudel v1.2.0 across mini-notation, pattern algebra, signals, and visualizers, plus the major missing systems (JS expression language, sample playback, full control set, chord/scale). Doubles as the priority roadmap for closing compatibility gaps.

epics.title: Audio Expansion — Ability Sound Effects
epics.summary: Add per-ability sound effects covering the class roster: grappling hook, demolitionist rocket, rogue stealth and backstab, mage beam and air-walk, healer wind gust, melee enrage, ranger reload, and summoner mark. Each .wav was synthesized and wired to its triggering gameplay event.

epics.title: Strudel Integration — Procedural Music Pattern Engine
epics.source: docs/epics/EPIC_strudel_integration.md; supporting specs docs/design/pattern_engine_spec.md and docs/design/strudel_compatibility.md
epics.summary: Port Strudel v1.2.0's pattern algebra and mini-notation to GDScript, driving GDSiON synthesis with a live-editing Music Drawer. Built depth-first as a separable plugin tree, prioritizing one complete end-to-end user-feedback path before broadening. All seven implementation phases shipped across v0.10.47 through v0.10.53.

stories.title: Pattern Core — The Algebra
stories.source: EPIC_strudel_integration.md EPIC 1 (Stories 1.1-1.9); commit 'Strudel pattern engine (live-coding music)'
stories.summary: Port the five core types (Fraction, TimeSpan, Hap, State, Pattern) and the full pattern algebra to GDScript, mathematically identical to Strudel v1.2.0. Includes combinators, composers, euclidean rhythms, and continuous signals.

tasks.title: Fraction type: exact rational arithmetic, comparison, cycle ops, conversion
TimeSpan: spanCycles, intersection, duration, cycleArc
Hap and State types with source-location context
Pattern foundation: queryArc, pure/silence/gap, reify, fmap, filters
Applicative + monadic ops: appBoth/Left/Right, bind/join, squeezeJoin
Combinators: stack/sequence/slowcat, fast/slow, every, rev, layer, ply
Composers: set/keep/add/sub/mul/div with hows, struct, mask
Euclidean rhythms: Bjorklund, euclid, euclidRot, euclidLegato
Continuous signals: saw, sine, tri, square, rand, range, segment

stories.title: Mini-Notation Parser
stories.summary: Port the krill PEG grammar to a hand-written recursive-descent GDScript parser producing an AST that converts to Pattern trees. Tracks source locations on every leaf for editor highlighting.

tasks.title: Lexer/tokenizer: atoms, rests, brackets, operators, source offsets
Recursive-descent parser: sequences, stacks, groups, slowcat, polymeter, operators
AST-to-Pattern: patternifyAST, applyOptions, alignment dispatch, leaf locations
Compatibility test: mini() output matches Strudel firstCycleValues

stories.title: Scheduler + GDSiON Bridge
stories.source: EPIC_strudel_integration.md EPIC 3 (Stories 3.1-3.4); commit 'Procedural adaptive music system (GDSiON)'
stories.summary: Connect the pattern engine to real-time audio via a cycle-based Cyclist scheduler and a Hap-to-SiON note_on bridge. Maps note/n/s/freq value types and per-note controls to GDSiON, integrated with the existing MusicManager.

epics.title: Music Composition Architecture
epics.summary: Add a Composition / Movement / Bridge / Turnaround / Record data layer on top of the Strudel engine so music is data independent of any UI. Extracts the line compiler out of the drawer, introduces a bar scheduler that hot-swaps patterns at cycle boundaries, and lets game events transition movements via bridges. Shipped across v0.10.41 (phases 3-5) and v0.10.72-v0.10.75.
